Setting Thumbline as your default launcher makes it your home screen, so the Home button always brings you here.
Pick your home apps. These sit at the bottom of your home screen, one tap away.
Optional. Switch on what you want now; each asks for its permission only when you turn it on. You can change all of these later in Settings.

Pick a starting profile, or keep things as they are. A profile sets home, pause, wellbeing and drawer options in one go. It never changes your wallpaper, theme, font, hidden apps or renamed apps. You can switch later in Settings.
Bare: a quiet home with four apps and a clock, nothing else.
Focus: five apps, a short pause before apps, quiet notifications and wind-down.
Rich: seven apps, weather, music glow, shortcuts and every Today card.
